visual.general_description: Three panels combine a 3D CT angiographic reconstruction with two operative photographs of ascending-aortic repair.
visual.detailed_description: Panels A, B and C run left to right in one horizontal strip. A is a red vascular reconstruction on black; B and C are color operative fields with red tubing, retractors and instruments. Large white-outlined panel labels appear at each lower-right. There are no graphs, axes or calibrated rulers; printed CT acquisition overlays are metadata rather than a clinical chart.

panels.general_description: Three-dimensional CT angiographic reconstruction of the aorta and adjacent outpouching.
panels.detailed_description: Left panel A shows a red three-dimensional vascular reconstruction on a black background. A curved large vessel has superior branches, a small side branch toward image-left, and a thin descending branch to image-right. An irregular orange-brown outpouching with a pale gray-white rim abuts the right side of the large vessel. Readable overlays include CT Cardiac Angiogram Coronary, Standard 3D, VR: Heart Vessels, Segmented LAD, 13 Oct 2023, 11:04:36, kVP:120, mA440, msec350, mAs:98, Krn:CARDIAC, Thk:0.5 mm and Aquilion Prime SP. Small P, A and I orientation letters accompany the larger bottom-right A panel label. No dimension ruler is drawn.

panels.general_description: Operative photograph with exposed tissue, cannulae and a metal instrument near an aortic defect.
panels.detailed_description: Middle panel B shows an open operative field containing red-orange tissue and yellow fat, bordered by metallic retractors. A long metal instrument descends from the upper edge toward a small reddish opening beside a pale rounded tissue surface in the lower-middle field. Red tubing and a white connector pass at the upper-left, and a thick red tube crosses diagonally. The large B label appears at lower-right. No ruler or printed defect size is visible.

evidence.quote: (b) Intraoperative image showing a 1-cm diameter defect (white arrow) on the right side, anterolaterally above the sinotubular junction connecting the pseudoaneurysm sac to the main aorta. Likely site of cardioplegia cannulation in previous cardiac surgery.

panels.general_description: Operative photograph documenting a sutured patch repair.
panels.detailed_description: Right panel C shows an open red-orange surgical field with a broad oval region of orange tissue at its center, surrounded by looping dark sutures. Two narrow metal instrument tips descend from a gloved hand at the top toward the lower edge of that oval region. Broad metal retractors line the sides. Red tubing and white connectors cross the bottom, a ribbed dark tube enters from lower-right, and blue/orange lines exit at bottom-right. The large C label is at lower-right. No ruler or patch dimensions are printed.

evidence.quote: (c) Intraoperative image shows reconstruction of ascending aorta at site of pseudoaneursym using an elliptical Gelweave patch.
